spiritgiven.comments: Really impressed with the level of contact and attitude on and off the field.

On reflection with the team, the level of contact improved however we felt we still had to adjust our game to accommodate the expectation of contact. Appreciate the receptive attitude and adjustments.
Appreciate the comments on exposure to culture and learning, but as it was a huge deal for us to play you, some feedback on the gameplay for us would be useful to reflect and take with us into future games.
Appreciate communication and cool heads throughout any calls and discussions on and off the field

Unfortunately, the level of contact was too much and was continuous throughout the game despite multiple approaches to the spirit captain to correct the issue. It gave a consistent unfair advantage to Venezuela and showed either a disregard for spirit or an inability to control one's body on the field. Rules knowledge was below average and although the team was receptive to learning the rules, there were repeated violations and infractions of the same rules.
Thanks for a good clean game, exemplified how ultimate should be played. Appreciate your attitude and temperament in all situations on and off the field.
Thanks for such a well spirited game, your attitude and fair mindedness to talk through the spirit time out was really appreciated, especially given the high pressure and tight game situation.
Great fair mindedness throughout the game and loved the attitude and interaction both on and off the field. Really clean lines and game overall, we would love for all games to be like this
Excellent avoidance of fouls and body contact throughout the game. I think the only game we've had with no pick calls.

spiritreceived.comments: really cool cultural experience, chants and gifts.
We had a few calls from NZ with feedback from their team and Vz was not able to adapt our game to to match the feedback. Overall a spirited game, but we had a tough time changing and adapting.
We had a spirit timeout because a NZ player picked up a rolling pull and then dropped it on the ground. We agreed to do a spirit timeout to clarify 13.6 and we replayed the point.
